summary: Arctic Falls AB (publ) engages in providing state-of-the-art testing facilities for the automotive and tyre industry. The company offers testing services for vehicles, components, and tires. It provides seven permanent testing facilities, five of which are outdoor and two indoors, providing access to a winter climate all year round. It also offers vehicle testing support upon request, ranging from endurance driving to vehicle evaluation, data collection, mileage collection, and measurements. In addition, the company facilitates Vintergatan, which provides a ground-based facility that offers a long and stable season, from mid-November until the end of March; plantskolan proving ground provides tyre testing and events on a land-based track, while Vidsel, Flurheden, and Nattberg proving grounds are contracted sites designed by customers for tyre testing. Arctic Falls AB (publ) was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Älvsbyn, Sweden.
